name: [🔨 Fixes] 🚽 Toilet Defense
desc:
🚽 Welcome to Toilet Defense! 🚽 

💰 Invite your friends to get money boost! 
👍 Use code 5KLikes to get extra money 

📢 Check out our new game: Toilet Defense X! https://www.roblox.com/games/15832202930/Toilet-Defense-X

⚔️ Kill & Destroy toilets using your units! 
🚽 Beat waves to win and get your reward! 
😰 Can you survive all the waves and kill the last hard boss? 

👍 Enjoy the game? Leave a thumbs up! 
🔔 Don't forget to favorite game and follow! 

Tags: Skibidi Toilet, Toilet Tower Defense, skibiti, toilet, TDS, TTD, bgs, bss, psx, fun, speed, ep 66, ep 67, Ninja Cameraman, Upgraded Titan Speakerman, gman, Plungerman, Speakerman vs Skibidi Toilet, free, rp, Titan Cinemaman, Titan Cameraman, meme, scary, #BringBacKTTD, Toilet Battles, Fight Toilets

scripts.title: SEVEN SCRIPT
scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()

local Window = Library.CreateLib("[🔨 Fixes] 🚽 Toilet Defense", "DarkTheme")

local Tab = Window:NewTab("BY ROBLOXSCRIPTSYT2")

local Section = Tab:NewSection("SEVEN SCRIPT")

local Tab = Window:NewTab("MAIN")

local Section = Tab:NewSection("ALL UNITS")

Section:NewButton("TV MAN", "ButtonInfo", function() local function getHeadPosition() local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer local character = player.Character if character then local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") if humanoid then local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") if head then return head.Position end end end return nil end

local headPosition = getHeadPosition() if headPosition then local A_1 = "TV Man" local A_2 = CFrame.new(headPosition) local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Functions.SpawnTower Event:InvokeServer(A_1, A_2) end

end)
